description: Lumeo is a modern, accessible Blazor component library with 130+ production-ready components. Built on Tailwind CSS v4 with 8 color themes, dark mode, and 14 locales. Features AI chat primitives (PromptInput, StreamingText, AgentMessage), motion primitives, Scheduler (FullCalendar), Gantt (Frappe), RichTextEditor (TipTap), 30+ ECharts, enterprise DataGrid with Excel/PDF/CSV export, programmatic overlay service, [LumeoForm] Roslyn source generator, RTL support, and 1,727 unit tests. Inspired by shadcn/ui and Radix.
title: Lumeo
